sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Leveraged Buyout Acquisition Syndicate and Special Purpose Co

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - U.S.-derived common law corporate statute modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law, supplemented by RMI statutory law and customary law elements; unitary national system without sub-state corporate law distinctions.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association (COFA) between the United States and the Republic of the Marshall Islands (effective 21 October 1986; Amended 2003) - economic assistance, trade and defense framework; not an investor-state BIT.
World Trade Organization (WTO) Member since 12 May 2004; no dedicated investment agreement under GATS for private equity SPVs.

Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) in force with the United States (2004; effective 2007), Australia, France, the Netherlands, and the Nordic countries (Denmark, Faroe Islands, Finland, Iceland, Norway, Sweden); no comprehensive Double Tax Agreement (DTAA) in force.
No Bilateral Investment Treaty (BIT) with investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) currently in force for the RMI.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Counter-Terrorism and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2012 (CTAMLA), as amended 2014/2017/2021 (Parts governing customer due diligence, record-keeping, reporting and the Financial Intelligence Unit); Banking Act 2011 (as amended); Business Corporations Act (Title 27, RMI Revised Code) Sections 6-8 (corporate name), 17-19 (registered agent and registered office), and 175 (register of shareholders); Corporate Registry Beneficial Ownership Schedule (BOS) and the Registrar of Corporations' electronic UBO database; FIU Guidance Notes on Customer Due Diligence (2021).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of each ultimate beneficial owner's (UBO's) passport and proof of residential address
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing government authority of the UBO's country of nationality; copy certified by a licensed professional (notary, attorney, or RMI registered agent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (RMI is a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention); consular legalization only if the country of issuance is not a Hague member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Subscriber declaration of beneficial ownership and source of funds (Form BOS/SOF, executed by the subscriber and each UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Subscriber / UBO signature witnessed before a notary public in the jurisdiction of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable; accepted by the RMI registered agent under CTAMLA CDD obligations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and AML questionnaire for the PE fund sponsor / GP and the SPV's source-of-funds provenance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution or the fund administrator's MLRO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if requested by the RMI registered agent) or notarized undertaking from the issuing institution; must be dated within 90 days

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the RMI registered agent (Form POA/A, executed by authorized signatories of the SPV or its ultimate parent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; consular legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Extract or records of the parent fund / general partner from its home registry (e.g., Delaware Division of Corporations or Cayman Islands CIMA), evidencing the UBO chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registry in the parent entity's domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Delaware / Cayman) or consular legalization where applicable

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, and UBOs against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the U.S. OFAC SDN List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the RMI FIU domestic watchlist; foreign and domestic PEPs (and their family members and close associates) trigger enhanced due diligence with senior-management approval; all negative news / sanctions hits must be documented and escalated; suspicious transaction reports (STRs) must be filed with the RMI FIU in accordance with CTAMLA deadlines; false UBO declarations carry criminal penalties under CTAMLA.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Corporate Registry - e-Registry portal operated by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Justice, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands; international applications are typically routed through licensed RMI registered agents.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Latin (Roman) script. Marshallese words are permitted but not required; non-English names must be transliterated into Roman characters and must be distinguishable within the Registry's alphabetical index. No statutory requirement to include a Marshallese-language suffix; the English designation Corporation, Incorporated, Company, Limited, or an authorized abbreviation is mandatory.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Limited (unless used as the statutory corporate designation)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is valid for 30 days and may be renewed by filing a fresh reservation application before expiry; each renewal grants a further 30-day period. If the Registrar rejects a name, the applicant (directly or through the RMI registered agent) may file a written appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 30 days of the rejection notice, attaching legal arguments on distinctiveness and permissible use, and may propose a revised name. The Registrar must issue a written decision within 5 business days of the appeal; a second rejection may be challenged by judicial review before the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands under the Business Corporations Act. Alternatively, the applicant may immediately re-file the reservation under a modified name; government fees are not refundable upon rejection.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible. The statutory registered office must be a physical address in the RMI maintained by a licensed registered agent (typically the agent's Majuro office); the SPV itself is not required to lease premises, maintain staff, or hold physical assets in the RMI. Remote board participation and unanimous written consent resolutions are permitted, so a virtual office arrangement (agent address, mail forwarding, electronic meetings) fully complies provided the registered agent remains licensed and resident in the RMI.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<5% probability in any 12-month period). The Registrar of Corporations and the RMI FIU conduct desk-based reviews and agent-level AML/CFT inspections rather than systematic unannounced on-site inspections of non-resident SPVs; however, the registered agent is subject to inspection at any time and may be required to produce SPV records within 48 hours.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee (Certificate of Incorporation for non-resident Business Corporation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: RMI Corporate Registry statutory fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: RMI Corporate Registry statutory fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office services (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for non-resident PE SPV corporate services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT client onboarding, UBO recordal processing, and Beneficial Ownership Schedule (BOS) filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI registered agent acting as regulated person under CTAMLA
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: CTAMLA compliance cost; delegated-agent prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP / OFAC / UN / EU consolidated list screening and customer risk-rating file (entity plus two UBOs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI registered agent / third-party compliance screening provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for screening software subscription and agent processing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of subscriber declarations, directors' consents, and specimen signatures (two execution packages)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial tariff in execution jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille processing of three documents (passport copy package, power of attorney, parent entity extract)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of the country of origin (e.g., U.S. Secretary of State / Cayman Islands)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille fee schedule plus courier disbursement

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal drafting and review of formation resolutions, UBO chain memo, and corporate governance skeleton
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market hourly or fixed-fee benchmark for PE SPV structuring

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier and secure digital transmission of apostilled bundle to RMI registered agent

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporation Act, 27 MIRC Ch. 2, §§ 102, 106, 110, 119, 122, 130
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Business Registration Division, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. The Corporation may issue subscriber shares for zero or nominal par value without an escrow account; paid-up capital may remain unfunded until the board calls contributions.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accept the subscription and issue fully paid shares per the subscription agreement; and be it further RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at [registered office], c/o [registered agent], and the registered agent be appointed; and be it further RESOLVED, that [Name] be appointed President and [Name] Secretary, with each to serve until successors are elected; and that the officers are authorized to execute all banking, financing, and documentation actions required for the private equity buyout SPV.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations online name reservation desk, Business Registration Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a unilateral name reservation request with the proposed corporate name and one alternate. Pay the name reservation fee, receive a reservation certificate valid for 30 days, and record the reservation reference for the Articles of Incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Copy of passport or government identification of the incorporator
Proof of payment of name reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for similarity or misleading intent, submit a corrected alternative name reservation without forfeiting the priority date; the registry notice must be cured within 14 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Formation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public in the jurisdiction where the incorporator signs
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare Articles of Incorporation on Form BC-1 containing the authorized capital, purpose clause limited to private equity buyout SPV activity, and the name and address of the initial registered agent. Have the incorporator execute the Articles and the separate consent of initial directors; notarize the signatures and attach the notarial certificates.
required_dossiers: Signed and notarized Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1)
Consent to Act of Initial Directors
Copy of incorporation resolution authorizing the SPV purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notarial certificate is insufficient under applicable Marshall Islands conflict-of-laws rules, re-execute the document before a notary admitted in the relevant foreign jurisdiction or obtain an apostille; no formal filing remedy is required until submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing and Statutory Review by Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Articles of Incorporation and the consent of initial directors at the Registrar's counter or through an authorized RMI filing agent, pay the incorporation fee, obtain the stamped registry copy, and await issuance of the certificate.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney or cover letter if filed by a registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues an objection or query, the filing agent has ten business days to amend or clarify the Articles by filing a curative statement; if not cured, the application is deemed withdrawn and fees may be retained or reapplied to a new filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation, confirm that the registered office is a physical address in the Marshall Islands and that the registered agent is licensed by the Registrar. File any post-incorporation statement, or amend the Articles if the initial agent named therein changes, and maintain the certificate of agent consent.
required_dossiers: Statement of Registered Office and Registered Agent
Written consent of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent's license has lapsed or the address is not physical, engage a substitute licensed agent and file a change of agent within five business days; failure to maintain an agent may render the company administratively dissolved after fifteen business days unless corrected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Business Registration Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the original Certificate of Incorporation, verify the company number and name against the registration database, and request a Certificate of Good Standing and, if needed, an incumbency certificate for bank and counterparty due diligence.
required_dossiers: Stamped receipt of the incorporation filing
Copy of final accepted Articles of Incorporation
Registry database excerpt or company number confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry database shows administrative lapse due to a missing annual license fee, pay the annual renewal fee and file an affidavit of active status before requesting the certificate; certificates are not issued while the company is listed as inactive.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial licensing board has jurisdiction over a passive financing SPV holding no physical operations in the Marshall Islands.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required — no operational or manufacturing permit for a tax-exempt non-resident business corporation formed exclusively for syndicated lending, equity acquisition, and private equity buyout SPV purposes.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI-EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no EIA filing required for a financial SPV with no development footprint or emission source.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable. Should any future physical holdings arise, the SPV would be required to comply with the EPA's wastewater and solids disposal standards for commercial facilities, including water quality discharge thresholds under the Environmental Protection Act 1986 and the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations 1999.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable — no physical premises. If a Majuro office is later opened, the company must obtain a fire safety certificate from the Majuro Fire Department, a structural occupancy clearance from the building control office, and a workplace safety inspection by the Ministry of Health and Human Services.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Customs Division, Ministry of Finance and Administration (no separate income tax agency); official government portal: https://www.mof.gov.mh
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) imposes no national income tax, no VAT, and no general corporate tax, so no statutory TIN/VAT ID is issued to a non-resident Business Corporation. A foreign entity obtains registration by filing Articles of Incorporation with the RMI Registrar of Corporations (through the RMI Corporate Registry/Maritime Administrator) and paying the annual registration fee. If the entity later imports goods, it must obtain a Customs Importer Code from the Revenue and Customs Division. A local business license is separately obtained for any substantive commercial presence in the RMI.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election, tax consolidation election, or hybrid-mismatch election exists because RMI has no income tax regime. The only statutory elections are corporate governance elections under the Business Corporations Act (e.g., share structure, by-laws, registered agent), which carry no tax classification consequences.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (RMI levies no VAT, GST, or sales and use tax; only customs import duties and social security contributions apply in limited circumstances)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. A Customs Importer Code is required on the first importation of goods into the RMI; no economic turnover threshold triggers tax registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not applicable - RMI has no electronic invoicing, real-time tax clearance, API-based reporting, or digital stamping mandate for invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable - because RMI has no VAT/GST system, there is no export VAT to zero-rate or refund. Exports from the RMI are outside the scope of indirect taxation; customs export declarations may still be filed for statistical and regulatory purposes.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (submitted under the RMI Customs and Excise regime, where statutorily required for the export movement)
Bill of lading or airway bill evidencing the physical export from the RMI
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Not applicable for VAT export fraud as no VAT system operates. Customs misdeclaration penalties, forfeiture of goods, fines up to the value of the goods, and criminal sanctions may apply under RMI customs law; abuse of the tax-exempt Business Corporation status may result in revocation of registration and statutory penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No domestic central bank exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). The U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender, and the United States Federal Reserve System is the de facto monetary authority for Federal Reserve notes in circulation in the RMI. The statutory banking and financial-institution supervisory function is discharged by the Banking Commissioner of the Republic of the Marshall Islands under the Banking Act 1989. There is no separate foreign exchange administration or exchange-control body.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: RMI maintains no exchange-control regime and no domestic currency. Both current-account and capital-account items are freely convertible in U.S. dollars, and profit remittances, debt-service payments, redemption proceeds and cross-border buyout distributions may be exported without central-bank approval or FX licensing. Practical remittance hurdles are operational only: bank-level AML/KYC verification, OFAC/UN sanctions screening, FATCA-related information exchange and contractual or security restrictions imposed by syndicated lending documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory timeline, no minimum percentage and no mandatory surrender obligation for export receipts in the RMI. Foreign-currency export proceeds may be retained, converted at commercial-bank rates or used directly to settle trade obligations. This rule is neutral for the private-equity buyout SPV because investment contributions and distributions are treated as capital flows and are not subject to export-proceeds surrender requirements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account for investor subscriptions and Operational USD Account for deal disbursements

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam - Majuro Branch (foreign bank licensed in RMI)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Account and Clearing Account for syndicated loan receipts and SWIFT settlement

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. The RMI does not maintain a separate electronic-money-institution (EMI) licensing class. Offshore digital EMI platforms are not permitted to take deposits or provide custodial, escrow or treasury services unless separately licensed under the Banking Act 1989 or the Trust Companies Act 2004 and approved by the Banking Commissioner. A non-resident digital EMI account is not a viable settlement rail for syndicated loan wires or leveraged-buyout disbursements and may be categorised as an unlicensed money-transmission channel.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a Medium_Risk_Enhanced private-equity buyout SPV, at least one director or senior officer with signing authority must appear physically at the bank's Majuro office for an in-person compliance interview. Remote opening is not generally available for this risk class. All other directors and every beneficial owner holding 25% or more must be identified through notarised or apostilled KYC packs, board resolutions and certified registered-agent or good-standing certificates; the bank retains absolute discretion to require additional physical appearance where the ownership chain is complex.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Passive non-resident SPV with no local office, no employees and no commercial substance beyond receiving syndicated buyout financing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing; registered-agent certificate; board resolution authorising the account; constitutional documents; group structure chart; ISIC 6499 business plan; source-of-funds letter; and a RMI legal opinion confirming the non-resident SPV is structured exclusively for the buyout transaction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multi-tier ownership chain involving foreign private-equity funds, Delaware or Cayman holding vehicles and undisclosed ultimate natural persons.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified ultimate-beneficial-ownership register identifying every natural person holding 25% or more; passport and residential-address evidence; ownership certificates from each holding company; professional private-bank reference letters; sponsor fund formation documents; and administrator KYC files.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound equity or debt transfers occurring immediately after account opening and before the SPV has any operating history.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed equity commitment letters; LMA-compliant facility term sheet and loan agreement; closing agenda; uses-of-funds schedule; target-company acquisition agreement; audited or reviewed sponsor and fund financial statements; and bank references confirming that originating accounts are held at regulated financial institutions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound payments to counterparties or jurisdictions flagged by sanctions screening or correspondent-bank negative-news review.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Itemised disbursement schedule with business justification; underlying acquisition and trade contracts; RMI counsel closing opinion; SWIFT tag 70 purpose descriptions; OFAC/UN screening clearance reports; and a board-approved beneficiary list with ongoing negative-news rationale.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity subscriptions and syndicated loan proceeds must arrive via authenticated SWIFT MT103 (or ISO 20022 pacs.008) in U.S. dollars to the SPV's segregated capital-escrow or operating account. The remitting bank must include the SPV's full legal name and RMI entity or LEI reference in beneficiary instructions, place 'MH_BC PE BUYOUT SPV' and the transaction type in tag 70, and provide SWIFT GPI tracking confirmation. No RMI exchange-control approval is required; USD clearing is completed through the receiving bank's U.S. correspondent via Fedwire or CHIPS. The receiving bank verifies each remitter against the approved investor and lender list and rejects unidentified or third-party wires. The transaction narrative or purpose code should state equity contribution or shareholder loan to a non-resident buyout SPV.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlement uses SWIFT MT103 for ordinary vendor, legal, advisory and lender payments; MT202 COV for correspondent cover; MT700 and MT707 for commercial letters of credit; and internal book transfer or USD bank draft for on-island payments. Acquisition disbursements are executed only against a board-approved disbursement schedule, signed signature-matrix instructions, supporting closing statements and a sanctions-cleared beneficiary list. Commercial letters of credit, where used, are issued and advised in accordance with UCP600 and ISBP745, supported by the underlying contract, commercial invoice, transport documents and bank-authorised reimbursement instructions. USD settlement is effected on a same-day basis through Fedwire or CHIPS; there is no government-operated local clearing house imposing FX settlement limits.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable FX forward contracts with RMI-licensed or OECD-domiciled bank counterparties for conversion of non-USD buyout proceeds or distributions
Non-deliverable forward contracts, including non-deliverable FX swaps, for currencies that lack onshore deliverability or RMI clearing access
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps documented under a 2002 ISDA Master Agreement with a Credit Support Annex for long-term syndicated-loan liabilities
FX swap and rollover facilities for temporary settlement-date mismatches between USD subscription receipts and non-USD trade payment obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Report (Form 121) and Annual Franchise Fee Statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Maritime and Corporate Registry (MIMRA), Majuro
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based: must be filed during the statutory window from 1 January to the anniversary of the original incorporation date in each calendar year; no statutory grace period applies.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late penalty of USD 75 per month or fraction of a month is assessed on overdue annual report fees; if annual reports and fees remain unpaid for three consecutive years, the Registrar is expressly authorised to administratively dissolve the corporation and cancel its certificate of incorporation under MIRC Title 51.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Confidential Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Record Refresh and AML/CFT Due-Diligence Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands registered agent acting as statutory point of contact for the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (Registrar maintains no public UBO register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in conjunction with the Form 121 filing cycle; updated contemporaneously upon every share transfer or change in control, with refreshed supporting documentation retained on file for seven years.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No direct government late fee; failure to refresh beneficial-ownership records constitutes an AML/CFT compliance breach that may subject the registered agent to regulatory sanction and impair the corporation's ability to retain a licensed registered agent.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is mandated under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (MIRC Title 51) for a non-resident private business corporation at any share-capital or revenue threshold; an independent certified audit is triggered only if the SPV is exchange-listed, holds a banking/insurance/trust licence, or is contractually required by private-equity lender and investor agreements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No local statutory GAAP is prescribed for non-resident business corporations; IFRS as issued by the IASB is the prevailing framework, with US GAAP accepted for US-investor private-equity vehicles; financial statements are maintained for investor and lender reporting rather than statutory filing.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, the corporate secretary audits the statutory registers against the share-transfer ledger and directors' consents; the licensed registered agent conducts a beneficial-ownership confirmation and CDD refresh aligned to the Form 121 anniversary cycle; every share transfer or control change requires a new UBO declaration and supporting identification, held confidentially under the Marshall Islands confidential beneficial-ownership framework and disclosed only to authorised authorities.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 750 - 2,500 per annum (licensed registered agent plus registered office, standard non-resident business corporation market range)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; USD 8,000 - 25,000 per engagement when a certified audit is required by PE lender or investor agreements

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (the Republic of the Marshall Islands levies no corporate income tax; the Income Tax Act has been repealed and a non-resident Business Corporation pays no tax on worldwide, foreign-source, or RMI-source income).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: None applicable: no tax-holiday or preferential-deduction regime exists because no income-tax base exists. The only annual sovereign charge on the BC is the franchise tax under the Business Corporations Act (BCA) s. 103, computed on authorized share capital (minimum USD 250).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income-tax return is prescribed by RMI law. The mandatory periodical filing is the Annual Return and Franchise Tax Remittance (BCA s. 103) submitted to the RMI Registrar of Corporations through the registered agent's electronic portal (Registrar's Online Corporate Registry).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (due on the corporation's anniversary of incorporation; no quarterly or monthly income-tax filings exist).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the anniversary date of the effective date of the Certificate of Incorporation (not the fiscal year-end); a late-payment surcharge accrues from the due date, and continued default leads to administrative dissolution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 1 - Registered Name and Registration (BC) Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the Business Corporation as stated on the Certificate of Incorporation and its RMI company/registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact registered name without alteration; confirm the entity is designated as a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 2 - Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and physical Majuro address of the RMI-licensed registered agent maintaining the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify the agent holds a current RMI license; an expired agent appointment is an immediate compliance breach.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names and residential addresses of all directors and officers currently in office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors need not be RMI residents; provide jurisdiction of residence and keep the public register and internal books current.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 4 - Authorized Capital and Franchise Tax Computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares and calculation of the annual franchise tax tier per the BCA s. 103 fee schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The tax is computed on authorized, not issued, share capital; the USD 250 minimum applies up to 1,000,000 authorized shares.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of natural-person beneficial owners and the full control chain, filed under the RMI Beneficial Ownership Rules 2023.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose each ultimate individual owner through the PE fund's LP/GP structure; nominee or bearer-style concealment is unlawful and triggers penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual confirmation of whether the entity carries on a Relevant Activity and, if so, a statement of compliance with the International Tax Compliance (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A leveraged buyout SPV is prima facie a pure equity holding company subject to the reduced substance test (employees and premises appropriate for holding equity participations, management and control in RMI); do not declare 'no relevant activity' if the SPV conducts financing, leasing, or fund-management functions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: 10% late-payment surcharge on the franchise tax after the due date; Registrar-imposed penalties for late or inaccurate Annual Returns and ESR filings; administrative strike-off and revocation of the Certificate of Good Standing for continuing default; reinstatement requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and restoration fees.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the Marshall Islands imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by a non-resident Business Corporation, irrespective of the recipient's residence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI has concluded no comprehensive double taxation agreement; no domestic DTA-relief protocol exists. Foreign withholding agents (including US qualified intermediaries and EU paying agents) typically accept an apostilled Certificate of Good Standing together with a Certificate of Non-Resident Domestic Status issued by the RMI Registrar to evidence beneficial ownership and domicile for foreign-law exemption or reduced-rate claims.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate on outbound royalties and debt interest; RMI law imposes no domestic withholding tax, no deemed-royalty provision, and no thin-capitalization or interest-stripping rule applicable to the SPV.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable - the RMI has no transfer-pricing statute and prescribes no Local File, Master File, or CbC thresholds in local currency (USD). By contrast, the International Tax Compliance (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019 apply where the SPV carries on a Relevant Activity (including finance and leasing, fund management, or holding-company business) and impose annual substance documentation and filing obligations.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Tax Compliance Act 2018 and the ESR Regulations 2019 require any RMI company carrying on a Relevant Activity to satisfy economic substance in the RMI. A pure equity holding company qualifies for the reduced substance test: adequate employees and premises proportionate to the holding of equity participations plus management and control in the RMI. A PE buyout SPV that extends intra-group financing or performs fund-management functions (managing investor assets) is subject to the full substance test, including core income-generating activities performed in the RMI, senior management presence, and annual ESR filing with the Registrar. Non-compliance is reported to the RMI tax-transparency authorities and may trigger information exchange with OECD jurisdictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly signing or submitting false Annual Returns, ESR declarations, or beneficial-ownership filings to the Registrar, or issuing false tax-residence or non-residence certificates to banks and investors to conceal the true ownership or commercial activity of the LBO SPV.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offences of false statements and perjury under the RMI Criminal Code and the BCA are punishable by fines and/or imprisonment; the Registrar may strike the company off the Register and invalidate issued certificates; fraudulent filings with foreign tax authorities additionally expose the SPV to the home-state penalties of the beneficial owners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who sign or procure false filings are personally liable to fines and custodial sentences; the High Court may impose restraint and departure-prohibition (travel ban) orders pending criminal proceedings and order civil restitution of diverted funds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Abuse and Economic Substance Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the SPV as a passive booking centre with no employees, premises, local management, or accounting records while claiming zero-tax status, or misclassifying active financing/fund-management activity as 'pure equity holding' to avoid the full ESR test.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Tax Compliance (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019, the Registrar may impose a financial penalty of up to USD 50,000 (with daily penalties for continuing non-compliance), strike the entity off the Register, and exchange adverse information with foreign tax authorities under the OECD transparency framework.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered agent may be individually fined for causing a false ESR declaration; courts may pierce the corporate veil where the entity is a sham, exposing directors and controlling PE sponsors to personal restitution, asset seizure, and travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting syndicated loan proceeds or investor capital from undisclosed or high-risk sources, executing layered SWIFT wires through unverified counterparties, using nominees to obscure ultimate ownership, or transacting with sanctioned persons or jurisdictions subject to FATF countermeasures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Money Laundering Control Act 2012 (as amended), failure to maintain AML/CFT controls, customer due diligence, and suspicious-transaction reporting attracts fines of up to USD 100,000 per violation and/or imprisonment of up to 10 years; the proceeds of prohibited arrangements are subject to civil and criminal forfeiture.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers with knowledge of or wilful blindness to laundering activity are prosecutable as principals; the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit may freeze bank accounts, impose departure bans, and seek confiscation orders against personal and corporate estates.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Beneficial Ownership and Corporate Secrecy Violation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the natural-person UBO declaration under the Beneficial Ownership Rules 2023, filing stale or inaccurate ownership information after LP/GP or shareholding changes, or structuring a chain of foreign intermediate entities to prevent disclosure of the ultimate individual investors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Non-compliance with the RMI Beneficial Ownership Rules is an offence punishable by Registrar-imposed monetary penalties, administrative dissolution, and loss of Good Standing; deliberate concealment engages criminal liability under RMI law and adverse reporting to foreign competent authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Signing directors and the registered agent bear individual liability for each default, including fines and disqualification; the RMI authorities may also transmit UBO intelligence to investor home states, triggering foreign civil and criminal enforcement against the PE sponsors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Director Fiduciary Breach and Unlawful Distributions (Veil Piercing)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Authorizing dividends, capital reductions, guarantees, or asset transfers in the leveraged buyout structure while the SPV is insolvent or undercapitalized, or approving self-dealing transactions with PE affiliates that prejudice senior syndicated lenders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Delaware-derived BCA, directors are liable to the corporation and its creditors for unlawful distributions and must restore amounts paid with interest; courts may award consequential and exemplary damages and disregard limited liability where the SPV operates as an instrumentality of the sponsor.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil exposes directors and controlling shareholders to civil restitution, disgorgement of profits, and personal liability for syndicated debt; fraudulent transfers trigger criminal fraud charges, travel bans, and imprisonment under the RMI Criminal Code.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Cross-Border Interest Stripping and Transfer-Price Contamination
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using back-to-back shareholder loans through the RMI SPV at non-arm's length rates, excessive debt-to-equity ratios, or undocumented management fees to shift profits out of the target company's jurisdiction, relying on the RMI's zero-tax status without economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: No RMI domestic TP penalty applies, but the target jurisdiction will impose its own sanctions: interest-deduction denial (e.g., US section 163(j)), CFC and GILTI inclusions, transfer-pricing adjustments, penalties on understated income, and OECD MAP/AEOI enforcement; RMI authorities cooperate by exchanging SPV financial information.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Fund managers and sponsor representatives who certify false loan terms or financial statements to lenders face personal liability for the resulting tax underpayments, restitution to the injured target company, and professional disqualification in the investors' home jurisdictions.
